typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Location as string,
		Who as string,
		DateTime as string,
		Company as string,
		CredentialHotstamp as string,
		{Event } as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Fname = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Company as string,
		Filename as string,
		Event as string,
		CredentialHotstamp as string,
		DateTime as string,
		Location as string,
		Who as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Company,
		Filename = Fname,
		Event = {Event },
		CredentialHotstamp,
		DateTime,
		Location,
		Who),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
